description:
Assess the impact of air density on wind turbine performance. 

Starting with the loaded sample project:
1. Open the 'HAWT BEM Simulation' module.
2. Define and run a simulation named 'Sim_SeaLevel' with Air Density = 1.225 kg/m^3 (keep other settings default).
3. Define and run a second simulation named 'Sim_HighAlt' with Air Density = 0.900 kg/m^3.
4. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/altitude_study.wpa'.
5. Compare the Maximum Power (kW) of both simulations. Create a report at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/altitude_report.txt' with the format:
   Sea Level Max Power: [Value] kW
   High Altitude Max Power: [Value] kW
   Ratio: [Value]
